14.14.title: Mariner 10 Maximum Data Rate Calculation
14.14.title_cn: 水手10号最大数据速率计算
14.14.description: The Mariner 10 spacecraft used to explore the planet Mercury in 1974 used BPSK with $P_b = 0.05$ ($E_b/n_0 = 1.4$ dB) to transmit image data back to Earth (a distance of about $1.6 \times 10^8$ km). The spacecraft transmitter operated at 2.295 GHz, with an antenna gain of 27.6 dB and a carrier power of 16.8 W. The ground station had an antenna with a gain of 61.3 dB and an overall system noise temperature of 13.5 K. Find the maximum possible data rate.
14.14.description_cn: 1974 年用于探索水星的水手 10 号航天器使用 BPSK 调制，误码率 $P_b = 0.05$（对应 $E_b/n_0 = 1.4$ dB）将图像数据传回地球（距离约 $1.6 \times 10^8$ km）。航天器发射机工作频率为 2.295 GHz，天线增益为 27.6 dB，载波功率为 16.8 W。地面站天线增益为 61.3 dB，系统总噪声温度为 13.5 K。求最大可能的数据速率。

EbN0_dB.description: Required energy per bit to noise density ratio

steps.title: Received Power Calculation (Friis Formula)
steps.title_cn: 接收功率计算（弗里斯公式）
steps.formula: $P_r = P_t G_t G_r \left(\frac{\lambda}{4\pi R}\right)^2$ \\ $\frac{\lambda}{4\pi R} = \frac{0.1307}{4\pi \times 1.6 \times 10^{11}} \approx 6.50 \times 10^{-14}$ \\ $\left(\frac{\lambda}{4\pi R}\right)^2 \approx 4.225 \times 10^{-27}$ \\ $P_r = 16.8 \times 575.44 \times 1.349 \times 10^6 \times 4.225 \times 10^{-27} \approx 5.512 \times 10^{-17} \text{ W}$
steps.formula_cn: $P_r = P_t G_t G_r \left(\frac{\lambda}{4\pi R}\right)^2$ \\ $\frac{\lambda}{4\pi R} = \frac{0.1307}{4\pi \times 1.6 \times 10^{11}} \approx 6.50 \times 10^{-14}$ \\ $\left(\frac{\lambda}{4\pi R}\right)^2 \approx 4.225 \times 10^{-27}$ \\ $P_r = 16.8 \times 575.44 \times 1.349 \times 10^6 \times 4.225 \times 10^{-27} \approx 5.512 \times 10^{-17} \text{ W}$
